                    ### Question
                    A 52-year-old man with chronic alcoholism presents to an ambulatory medical clinic, where the hepatologist elects to perform comprehensive hepatitis B screening, in addition to several other screening and preventative measures. Given the following choices, which serologic marker, if positive, would indicate the patient has immunity to the hepatitis B virus?

                    ### Options

opb. HBsAb
opc. HBcAbrn
opd. HBeAg
ope. HBeAb

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
The presence of HBsAb (hepatitis B surface antibody) indicates immunity to the hepatitis B virus. Antibodies against hepatitis B virus lead to immunity, as supported by standard medical consensus and the evidence paths showing the relationship between antibodies and immunity.
